name: AI Starter Care Package 🎒
description_md:
# What You Get

- Automated client onboarding template — welcome emails, Drive folder + tailored onboarding checklist to get new clients live fast (attached: Automated Client Onboarding with AI-Generated Checklist.json).

- Social media calendar generator — AI topic ideation → platform-ready posts → image prompts → Airtable integration (attached: AI Social Media Content Calendar Generator with Airtable Integration.json).

- Daily RSS news digest to Slack/Discord — curated morning digest from your feeds (attached: Daily RSS News Digest to Slack and Discord.json).

- LinkedIn post lab — industry research → scroll-stopping drafts and post automation (attached: LinkedIn Content Generator with Industry Research and Post Automation.json).

- Smart task escalation manager — scans trackers, grades overdue items, and drafts contextual escalation messages (attached: Smart Project Task Escalation Manager.json).

- Daily standup assistant — collect replies, auto-summarize, and archive to Google Drive for easy review (attached: Daily Standup Automation with AI Summary and Archive.json).

- Google Drive knowledge-base assistant — auto-ingest Drive files and power a searchable chat assistant for your docs (attached: Google Drive Knowledge Base Assistant.json).

- Lead intake auto-responder — instant, personalized first-touch emails tailored to a lead’s industry and needs (attached: Lead Intake Auto-Responder for Consultancy Services.json).

- Slack → YouTube content helper — turn Slack threads into YouTube outlines and upload-ready assets (attached: Slack to YouTube Content Generator.json).

- Voice-notes → searchable knowledge base — transcribe and index voice notes so your team can query them instantly (attached: Voice Notes to Searchable Knowledge Base.json).Overwhelmed with value and want even more? 

Join my Early AI-dopters community: https://www.skool.com/earlyaidopters/about
